This repository provides the data products and supporting documentation for the study "Global biodiversity impacts of agricultural intensification are highly concentrated: A crop-resolved spatio-temporal analysis (2000–2019)". The archive contains three global NetCDF datasets at 0.25° spatial resolution covering the period 2000–2019:(i) sub-pixel land-use area by land-use type and intensity class,(ii) biodiversity impact estimates derived from characterization factors,and (iii) crop-type fractions by land-use type and intensity. Land-use types include cropland, plantations, pasture, rangeland…
